assignments.name: Google Ads offline conversions arrive late
CallRail claims faster sync than Invoca

turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: [PERSON_1], [PERSON_2], forwarding the brightline thread. [PERSON_3] has the timing data on the google ads uploads & [PERSON_4]'s on it too b/c their cmo noticed the cpa jump. fyi they're also getting callrail outreach claiming same-day sync. pasting the bit from our call last week where [PERSON_3] walked me through it (below).

turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: need to get ahead of this before it turns into a renewal conversation, they renew jan 15. [PERSON_2], can you pull the upload logs for their account for the last two weeks? want to see if it's consistent or just this batch.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: [PERSON_3]: i pulled the timestamps [inaudible] last batch. call came in october 6 at 9:14am, conversion didn't land in google adds until october 9 that's 72 hours [PERSON_4]: and the cmo saw the cpa spike before the conversions even posted. so he's looking at a number that doesn't have the full picture yet [PERSON_3]: Right And it's not just that one. Every batch I've checked is landing at least 48 hours out

turns.speaker: [PERSON_4]
turns.text: Adding to what [PERSON_3] sent. Our CMO flagged the CPA jump on the HVAC campaigns in Monday's standup. He's asking why our cost per booked job went up 18% week-over-week when nothing changed on our end in Google Ads.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_4]
turns.text: My read is that the delayed conversions are the reason. Google can't optimize toward conversions it doesn't have yet, so it's spending against a two-day-old signal. But I want to confirm that with you before I tell him that's the cause.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_4]
turns.text: [PERSON_3] has been tracking this for a couple weeks now. It's not a one-off. Every batch I've looked at is landing 48 to 72 hours out. We're also getting some noise from a competitor reaching out, which is its own distraction I'd rather not deal with right now.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_4]
turns.text: Can we get someone from your integrations team on a call this week? I'd like to walk through the timing with whoever owns the Google Ads connection.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_4]
turns.text: [PERSON_4] Director of Marketing Brightline Home Services [EMAIL_1]

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Wanted to put some specifics in writing since we've been going back and forth on this for a bit.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Our offline conversion uploads for the Booked Job action are arriving in Google Ads 48 to 72 hours after the call. I pulled a few examples from last week so you can see what I'm looking at:

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Call date | Conversion date in Google Ads Oct 5, 10:22am | Oct 7, 3:48pm Oct 6, 9:14am | Oct 9, 8:02am Oct 7, 2:05pm | Oct 9, 11:31pm Oct 8, 4:40pm | Oct 11, 8:55am

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: For Smart Bidding this is a problem because the bids are working off stale data. We're bidding on what happened two days ago instead of what's happening now. [PERSON_4] can speak to the business impact better than I can but I wanted you to have the raw timing.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Is there anything on the Invoca side that would explain why the uploads are landing that late? Happy to pull more examples if it helps.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: [PERSON_3] Marketing Operations Specialist Brightline Home Services [EMAIL_2]
